segments.name: Scores
segments.evidence: Our Scores segment includes our business-to-business ("B2B") scoring solutions and services which give our clients access to predictive credit and other scores that can be easily integrated into their transaction streams and decision-making processes.

segments.name: Software
segments.description: Provides decisioning capabilities, models, solutions and professional services for account origination, customer management, customer engagement, fraud detection and marketing, sold as SaaS or on-premises software.
segments.evidence: Our Software segment includes decisioning capabilities, models and solutions designed to operationalize intelligence across specific types of business needs or processes — such as account origination, customer management, customer engagement, fraud detection, and marketing — as well as associated professional services.

revenueModel.text: Consumer reporting agencies pay FICO a fee for each score generated, consumers pay for myFICO.com subscriptions, and business customers pay multi-year software subscription fees based on usage metrics.
revenueModel.evidence: Users of our scores generally pay the consumer reporting agencies a fee for each individual score generated by our algorithms, and the consumer reporting agencies pay an associated fee to us.
